Where
Onlinevirtual classroom on Zoom and the Moodle platform

Online lessons help you improve your Italian with a qualified teacher, on the days and at the times you prefer. Diction lessons help you perfect your pronunciation.

Besides Zoom, we use Moodle and Google to share audio and video and for online exercises. You can also prepare for the CILS and Roma Tre certification exams.

Each set of 10 lessons includes
  • 8 live general Italian lessons
  • 2 live pronunciation lessons
  • Self-study activities, with feedback from the teacher
  • Course materials and access to the Moodle platform

Plan your course

1. Let’s talk

Book an online meeting or a free trial lesson to plan your course.

2. The test

If you are not a beginner, ask for a placement test.

3. Your times

Tell us the days and times that work for you. We will do our best to fit them.

4. Off you go

You receive your schedule, the link to the virtual classroom, the course materials and your Moodle codes.

Booking and cancellation

Book your course with our form. We will contact you within 1 working day.

All times are Italian time. Please be at your computer or phone at least five minutes before your lesson starts.

To cancel a booked lesson, email info@aliassisi.it at least 24 hours before it starts, and it will be rescheduled. Lessons cancelled later cannot be rescheduled.

Booked lessons must be completed within 12 months.
